name: Quizzmaster Quinn
source:
Quinn appears in several routes. He is found on your second date with [url=/c64150]Hugo[/url], hosting trivia night in Charcutiepie. On [url=/c64151]Joseph[/url]'s second date, Quinn is working as a DJ for the youth group mixer. On your final date with [url=/c64153]Robert[/url], Quinn is leading a haunted tour of Maple Bay.

He is mentioned to have several more jobs, has a business card and, as we learn in some routes, a rocky relationship with his wife.

[From [url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/DreamDaddy]TVTropes[/url] and the [url=https://dreamdaddy.fandom.com/wiki/Quizzmaster_Quinn]Wiki[/url].]
